payload.origin: post-hoc verification of the refine-bctc-slot-4 spawn dispatched this tick (agent completed at ~16:42Z)

findings.title: HEAD-OF-LINE BLOCK — get_bctc_pending_refine serves a fully-FAILED finalized report at result[0]; both refine slots will re-pick it forever and never reach the 4 genuinely-pending reports behind it
findings.owner_suggestion: dev-mcp-server (tool query predicate) via po triage
findings.mechanism: The refine-bctc-slot-3 (11:00 UTC) and slot-4 (16:30 UTC) trigger prompts both instruct: 'Call get_bctc_pending_refine (limit:1), pick the OLDEST pending row (result[0])'. The tool's result set includes rows whose refine_status is FAILED, not only PENDING. POW_2026_Q1.pdf (report_id 78b06684-dca5-45e7-8dfd-b173df3d3d02) was finalized FAILED this tick with done_ct=0 / failed_ct=28 across all 28 windows — it has ZERO remaining windows to process — and it is STILL returned at result[0].
findings.live_evidence: cowork-team called get_bctc_pending_refine(limit:5) AFTER the agent finalized the report. Result[0] = POW_2026_Q1.pdf with refine_status='FAILED', text_status='COMPLETE'. Positions 1-4 = DPM_2025_Q4 (47p), REE_2025_Q4 (24p), DPM_2026_Q1 (47p), VPB_2026_Q1 (80p) — ALL refine_status='PENDING' with text_status='COMPLETE', i.e. genuinely ready to refine and fully blocked behind a dead head row.
findings.consequence: The two refine slots that were specifically added to drain the BCTC refine backlog are now no-ops in perpetuity. Each fire claims the lock, picks POW, finds an empty remaining-window set, and exits. The backlog behind it never moves. This silently defeats the drain rather than failing loudly — telemetry will read as a successful slot fire every time.
findings.prior_art_checked: Searched signal_queue and the board for pending_refine / head-of-line / FAILED-row-retry: NO prior art for this specific defect. Adjacent-but-distinct rows exist and were NOT duplicated — FIX-BCTC-REFINE-DURABLE-TRIGGER-BACKSTOP and the refine-dispatch-dormancy family are about the trigger not FIRING; this is the opposite failure mode (the trigger fires correctly and the queue query hands it dead work). The 'BCTC Refine Backlog Drain — THROUGHPUT-DRAIN' row is about volume, not head-of-line ordering.
findings.requested_action: Decide whether get_bctc_pending_refine should (a) exclude refine_status='FAILED' entirely, (b) exclude only FAILED rows with zero unprocessed windows, or (c) keep serving them but have the slot prompt select the first row with remaining work. Option (b) preserves genuine retry of transiently-failed reports while unblocking the queue. cowork-team did NOT change the tool or the slot prompts — dispatcher must not self-modify its own dispatch contract.

findings.title: ADVISORY — the spawned agent's recommended investigation target is wrong-rooted; do not open an OCR/text-extraction task on this evidence alone
findings.claim_as_reported: The refine_bctc_md agent reported that all 24 prior units failed with 'agent_error:text_fetch_failed' and recommended: 'Investigate upstream text extraction pipeline (get_bctc_page_text) for POW reports. This systematic FAILED status suggests data layer issue, not refiner capability.'
findings.counter_evidence: (a) The store reports text_status='COMPLETE' for this report_id. (b) cowork-team called get_bctc_page_text(report_id=78b06684..., page_number=1) — one of the 24 pages said to have failed — and it returned full Vietnamese OCR text with source='sqlite_ocr'. (c) The agent's own report contradicts its conclusion: it states 'Page 28 text retrieved successfully'.
findings.explicit_limit_on_this_refutation: This refutes the recommendation as a CURRENT root cause. It does NOT prove text was retrievable at the time the 24 units failed (a prior fire, 2026-07-19); text could have been backfilled since. cowork-team did NOT verify the 07-19 state and does not claim the original failures were bogus — only that pointing an implementer at get_bctc_page_text today would send them at a component that demonstrably works.
findings.pattern_note: This is the SECOND consecutive tick in which a cowork agent escalated a diagnosis whose named root cause is contradicted by a direct probe of the same component (prior: news-scout's get_agent_signals from_agent=null claim, corrected in cow-20260721T162324). Two instances is not yet a mechanism, but if a third appears the shared factor — agents attributing transport/resource failures to data-layer contracts without probing the contract — is worth its own row.

findings.title: An agent-side context-budget limit was written into permanent report state as a data failure
findings.mechanism: For the final 4 windows the agent reported the page-28 image fetch returned ~1.2MB of base64 that 'exceeded context token budget'. That is a limit of the SUBAGENT's context window, not a property of the document or the pipeline. Per its error-boundary contract the agent then pushed FAILED for those windows and called finalize_bctc_refine, producing refine_status=FAILED with failed_ct=28.
findings.why_it_matters: The failure reason is now indistinguishable, in stored state, from a genuine data defect. A future remediation pass reading 'failed_ct=28' cannot tell that some of those windows failed because a transcription worker could not hold a 1.2MB image, not because the page is unreadable. Combined with FINDING-1 this is also what makes the head row permanently dead: the finalization is sticky.
findings.scoping_caution: The agent followed its documented graceful-degradation contract — this is NOT filed as agent misbehaviour. The defect is that the contract has no distinct terminal status for 'worker could not process within its own resource envelope' versus 'source data is bad'. Prior art FIX-BCTC-... reingest guard (56/56 FAILED/empty-markdown, data-loss guard refused to wipe bctc_table_rows) shows the downstream cost of that ambiguity is already being paid elsewhere.
findings.requested_action: Consider a distinct status (e.g. DEFERRED / RESOURCE_EXCEEDED) that does not finalize the report and leaves the window re-attemptable by a worker with a larger budget or an image-downscale path. Do not treat this as the same class as text_fetch_failed.

dispatcher_self_report.note: The slot fired correctly and the agent honoured its contract. The finding is not about the dispatch — it is about the work the queue handed it. cowork-team verified the agent's output against the store rather than relaying its self-report, per feedback_agent_selfreport_metalayer_confabulation.
